newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold says most mines hit by strike.
newsitem.headline: Randgold says most mines hit by strike.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said on Monday that production at four of its six mines had been halted due to a one-day strike call by South Africa's biggest labour federation Cosatu.
A spokeswoman for Randgold said that Blyvooruitzicht Gold Mining Co Ltd had a 75 percent turnout for work and the entire workforce at Buffelsfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd was working.
But miners were not working at Doornfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd, nor was there any production at Harmony Gold Mining Ltd, the Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd and East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd.

The Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) has mobilised for a one-day strike to protest the Basic Conditions of Employment Bill which has already passed through Cabinet and is expected to be tabled before parliament soon.
It is demanding a 40-hour working week, six months maternity leave and double pay for Sunday work.
